lines.en: label dormwartwo2:
scene anewinterview1
: And we’re live! Welcome back to another installment of pre-war interviews hosted by the remarkable Molly Moyra MacCormack and her lovely assistant, Ayane (Insert Middle Name Here) Amamiya!
lines.zh: : 我们开播啦！欢迎收看新一期的赛前采访，由了不起的 Molly Moyra MacCormack 和她可爱的助手 Ayane（中间名待填）Amamiya 共同主持！

lines.en: : I’m not your assistant! And Japanese people don’t have middle names!
lines.zh: : 我才不是你的助手！而且日本人根本没有中间名！

lines.en: scene anewinterview2
: Well said! And sincerest apologies for attempting to hog the spotlight when that’s all I did last Samhain!
lines.zh: : 说得好！上次 Samhain 节我净顾着抢风头了，在此致以最诚挚的歉意！

lines.en: : You were extremely drunk and extremely loud!
lines.zh: : 你当时醉得厉害，嗓门还特别大！

lines.en: scene anewinterview3

: And right now I’m just extremely loud! But there’s good reason for that, because we’ve got a load of interviews for you viewers at home that are sure to get your bones quaking and your pants tightening!
lines.zh: : 现在我只是嗓门特别大！不过这是有原因的，因为我们为收看节目的各位准备了一大堆采访，保证让你们骨头打颤、裤子发紧！

lines.en: : That’s right, ladies and gentlemen. Through meticulous planning and a good nine or ten arguments, we’ve finally got a lineup of memorable, action packed competitions that’ll make last year's wars look more like...
lines.zh: : 没错，女士们先生们。经过周密的计划，还有足足九到十场争执，我们终于敲定了一连串令人难忘、紧张刺激的比赛，会让去年的大战看起来更像……

lines.en: : I don’t know. A big thumb wrestle or something. And Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Thumb Wrestle doesn’t exactly have a good ring to it.
lines.zh: : 我说不上来。就像一场大型扳手腕什么的。而且「超级无敌终极宿舍扳手腕大赛」听着也不怎么响亮。

lines.en: scene anewinterview4
: The point! You’re losing it!
lines.zh: : 重点！你跑题了！

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m not used to being on camera.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不太习惯上镜。

lines.en: : Then get lost and start prepping for the next interview while I take it from here! If there’s anything Molly MacCormack is good at- well, besides repeatedly spending all of my allowance on JPEGs...it’s pointless banter!
lines.zh: : 那就一边儿待着去，准备下一场采访，这边交给我！要说 Molly MacCormack 擅长什么——除了三番五次把零花钱全花在 JPEG 上以外……那就是毫无意义的插科打诨！

lines.en: scene anewinterview5
: And also managing to hold my tears in when my favorite characters die in anime and manga. It really just doesn’t hit the same as it used to, you know?
lines.zh: : 还有在动漫里最喜欢的角色死掉时把眼泪憋回去。那种感觉真的已经不像从前了，你懂吗？

lines.en: : Sure! I’m gonna go over there now, though, so...
lines.zh: : 当然！不过我现在要过去了，所以……

lines.en: : Take it away Molly!
lines.zh: : 交给你了，Molly！

lines.en: scene anewinterview6
: At last, you and I have reunited at the edge of the world. How unfortunate that our rendezvous has come just mere moments before the light of Re-Horakhty rains down upon us all.
lines.zh: : 终于，你我在世界尽头重逢了。多么不幸，我们的相会偏偏赶上 Re-Horakhty 之光即将倾泻在我们所有人身上的前一刻。

lines.en: : But in these final moments, know that I regret nothing. And that all that’s sure to come over the next 48 hours is just a final way for me to-
lines.zh: : 但在这最后的时刻，请知晓我毫无悔意。接下来 48 小时里注定要发生的一切，不过是我最后的一种方式，用来——

lines.en: : Molly! I’m ready!
lines.zh: : Molly！我准备好了！

lines.en: scene anewinterview7
: Ayane! You ruined my monologue! I was finally the main heroine and that was my moment to shine!
lines.zh: : Ayane！你毁了我的独白！我好不容易当上第一女主角，那可是我的高光时刻！

lines.en: : Shine for who? The camera guy?
lines.zh: : 对谁高光？对摄影师吗？

lines.en: scene anewinterview8
: Wait, yeah. Who are you any-
lines.zh: : 等等，对啊。你到底是谁——

lines.en: scene anewinterview9
: I’m joined now by my co-host’s competitor in what will be our first competition of the second annual Dorm Wars, Sana Sakakibara.
lines.zh: : 现在坐在我身边的，是我搭档的对手、第二届宿舍大战首场比赛的参赛者——Sana Sakakibara。

lines.en: : Sana, after competing in something as “outside of your comfort zone” as last year’s fashion show, how does it feel to return to something more “up your alley” like gaming?
lines.zh: : Sana，在参加了去年那场「完全超出你舒适区」的时装秀之后，回到像打游戏这样「对胃口」的项目上，感觉如何？

lines.en: : It feels, umm...really good, but...I still don’t really know what games we’re going to play or...or how good Molly is at games in general, so...
lines.zh: : 感觉，嗯……非常好，但是……我还是不太清楚我们要玩什么游戏，或者……或者 Molly 打游戏到底有多厉害，所以……

lines.en: : Word on the street is that you’ve been using performance enhancing drugs ahead of the competition to prepare yourself for certain victory. Do you have anything to say about these allegations?
lines.zh: : 有传言说，你在赛前使用了提升表现的药物，为必胜做准备。对这些指控你有什么要说的吗？

lines.en: : Do they...have...performance enhancing drugs for...video games?
lines.zh: : 有……有专门给……电子游戏用的提升表现药物吗？

lines.en: : Playing the fool, I see. A valiant strategy. But never fear, Sana. I’ll always have your back no matter what. Even if you {i}are{/i} taking drugs.
lines.zh: : 装傻是吧。很勇敢的策略。不过别怕，Sana。无论怎样我都会站在你这边。就算你{i}真的{/i}在嗑药。

lines.en: : But I’m...I’m not-
lines.zh: : 可我……我没有——

lines.en: : Final question, if you had to describe yourself with a flavor of Pop-tart, what would it be?
lines.zh: : 最后一个问题，如果要用一种 Pop-tart 的口味来形容自己，你会选什么？

lines.en: : Wha...what?! What does that have to do with-
lines.zh: : 什……什么？！这和有什么关系——

lines.en: scene anewinterview10
: And that’s everything from Sana, ladies and gentlemen! Be sure to cast your vote for her during her contest tomorrow morning by texting “POPTART” to 867405!
lines.zh: : 以上就是来自 Sana 的全部内容，女士们先生们！明天上午比赛时，别忘了发短信「POPTART」到 867405 为她投票！

lines.en: : Ayane, I don’t even know what a Pop-tart is!
lines.zh: : Ayane，我连 Pop-tart 是什么都不知道啊！

lines.en: scene anewinterview11
: Our next interview is with Touka and Makoto, daughters of the women competing in the contest that many have begun calling the “Battle of the MILFs!”
lines.zh: : 我们接下来的采访对象是 Touka 和 Makoto——一场已经渐渐被大家称为「MILF 之战」的比赛中，两位参赛母亲的女儿！

lines.en: : No one has started calling it that. You are the first person.
lines.zh: : 根本没人那么叫。你是第一个。

lines.en: : Can someone please explain to me what a “MILF” is? Is it anything like a WAP? Because my mother has not stopped saying that word as of late and I am beginning to fear for her health.
lines.zh: : 谁能给我解释一下「MILF」是什么意思？和 WAP 差不多吗？因为我母亲最近一直在说这个词，我都开始替她的身体担心了。

lines.en: : I mean...maybe a {i}little?{/i} Just...think of it meaning a hot mom or something!
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许{i}有点？{/i}就当是……辣妈之类的意思吧！

lines.en: : It’s the midst of summer. We’re all hot.
lines.zh: : 现在是盛夏。我们都很热。

lines.en: : Do I really have to do this? I wanted to go to lie down early tonight.
lines.zh: : 我真非得参加这个吗？我今晚本来想早点躺下的。

lines.en: scene anewinterview12
: J...Just humor me for a minute, okay?
lines.zh: : 就……就配合我一下好吗？

lines.en: : How are you guys feeling about your battle with one another? Any lingering worries? Like...Like what the Herald of the Adolescents may get up to with your respective mothers?
lines.zh: : 你们对彼此之间的对决有什么感觉？还有什么挥之不去的担忧吗？比如……比如那个「青春传令官」会和你们的母亲搞出点什么？

lines.en: : He wouldn’t be much of an adolescent herald if he was spending time heralding grown women, would he?
lines.zh: : 要是他把时间花在向成年女性传令上，那他还算什么青春传令官，对吧？

lines.en: : That said, I don’t really care one way or the other. I’ve already accepted that Touka’s mother is very likely going to win and that mine is going to make the two of us look like fools.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，我其实怎么都无所谓。我已经接受了 Touka 的妈妈很可能会赢，而我妈会让我们俩看起来像两个傻子。

lines.en: scene anewinterview13
: I also believe my mother is going to win, but that isn’t a passive aggressive means of talking down on Makoto’s mother, who I’m sure is a lovely and caring woman.
lines.zh: : 我也相信我母亲会赢，但这绝不是拐弯抹角地贬低 Makoto 的母亲——我相信她一定是个可爱又体贴的女人。

lines.en: : She’s certainly a woman, alright.
lines.zh: : 她确实是个女人，没错。

lines.en: : So, you’re not at all worried of Sensei using his protagonist powers to win your mother over while the two of them are alone?
lines.zh: : 那么，你们一点也不担心老师会趁两人独处时，用他的主角光环把你母亲拿下吗？

lines.en: : Of course not, for I’ll be with them the whole time. And I doubt his powers are strong enough to win both of us at once.
lines.zh: : 当然不会，因为我会全程跟着她们。而且我怀疑他的能力还不足以同时拿下我们两个。

lines.en: scene anewinterview14
: I wouldn’t be so sure of that. The list of tags in life is pretty incomparable, you know? I’m sure it wouldn’t be the first time a teacher has- you know what? Now’s not the time.
lines.zh: : 这我可不敢那么肯定。人生里那些「标签」的清单可是相当无敌的，你知道吗？我敢说老师干这种事也不是第一次了——算了，现在不是说这个的时候。

lines.en: scene anewinterview15
: I do want to end with one final question for Makoto, though.
lines.zh: : 不过最后我想再问 Makoto 一个问题。

lines.en: : For me specifically? What is it?
lines.zh: : 专门问我的？什么问题？

lines.en: : How are you doing? We’re all glad that you’ve been coming back to school, but-
lines.zh: : 你最近怎么样？大家都很高兴你能回来上学，不过——

lines.en: : I’m fine and ready to move on. Thanks for asking.
lines.zh: : 我很好，也准备好往前看了。谢谢关心。

lines.en: : Are you sure there’s nothing more we-
lines.zh: : 你确定没有别的我们——

lines.en: : I am. Thank you. Are we done now?
lines.zh: : 我确定。谢谢。可以结束了吗？

lines.en: : Oh, I...I guess so.
lines.zh: : 哦，我……我想是的。

lines.en: scene anewinterview16
: Well, that’s great news as I am here with two more competitors for what is sure to be one of the craziest contests we’ll have all year!
lines.zh: : 好消息是，我现在身边是另外两位参赛者，她们要参加的一定会是今年最疯狂的比赛之一！

lines.en: : {i}Help me...{/i}
: This morning, I awoke with scratches all over my body. When I looked in the mirror, I noticed they spelled “Ezekiel.”
lines.zh: : 今天早上醒来时，我发现自己全身都是抓痕。照镜子的时候，我注意到它们拼出了「Ezekiel」。

lines.en: : I am unsure of whether or not this relates or pertains to the contest, but I will try my very best to win at whatever that may be before being squished like a bug beneath Rin’s boots.
lines.zh: : 我不确定这跟比赛有没有关系，但我会尽我所能，在像虫子一样被 Rin 的靴子碾碎之前，赢下那可能的一切。

lines.en: : Again, {i}help me...{/i}
lines.zh: : 再说一次，{i}救救我{/i}……

lines.en: : Rin, you seem a little intimidated by your rival in this year’s matchup. Does that fear have anything to do with what many have been citing as “ESP” from Yasu?
lines.zh: : Rin，你似乎被今年的对手吓到了。这种恐惧是不是和很多人说的 Yasu 的「超能力」有关？

lines.en: : Uhh-
: When I look into your eyes, it’s like peering through two cracked glass spheres, each one splintering out as those cracks become new veins on the inside of your face.
lines.zh: : 当我望进你的眼睛，就像透过两颗布满裂纹的玻璃球向内窥视，每一道裂纹都在你脸的内侧分裂出新的血管。

lines.en: : Nope. Nothing to do with the “ESP” or whatever. Just not sure if I’m going to be sacrificed.
lines.zh: : 不。跟什么「超能力」没关系。只是不确定自己会不会被献祭。

lines.en: : He who has awakened will not take your life, Rin. Though, He may ask for something else in return for salvation. But I can assure you that what is meant to be taken is never meant to be mourned.
lines.zh: : 那已觉醒者不会取走你的性命，Rin。不过，作为救赎的交换，祂也许会索要别的东西。但我可以向你保证，注定被夺走的东西，从不需要被哀悼。

lines.en: : Its passing will only serve to make you stronger.
lines.zh: : 它的逝去只会让你变得更强大。

lines.en: scene anewinterview17
: Uh-huh. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。是啊。

lines.en: : I’m gonna go...to the bathroom now.
lines.zh: : 我要去……上个厕所。

lines.en: : May I accompany you? I can’t find Touka and often get lost when I am not following behind someone.
lines.zh: : 我可以陪你去吗？我找不到 Touka，而且不跟在别人身后的时候经常会走丢。

lines.en: scene anewinterview18
: Touka?! Where are you?! Please come get your child!
lines.zh: : Touka？！你在哪儿？！快把你家孩子领走！

lines.en: scene anewinterview19
: Up next, we have the Kendo Princess, Tsuneyo Tojo, sporting the latest MacCormack creation! A costume based on a character in a video game that is definitely not made for lolicons!
lines.zh: : 接下来登场的是剑道公主 Tsuneyo Tojo，她穿着 MacCormack 的最新作品！那是一套基于某款电子游戏角色的装扮，而且绝对不是给萝莉控做的！

lines.en: : We also have Miss Imani Imai, who has been admiring said costume ever since school ended!
lines.zh: : 同时我们还请到了 Imani Imai 小姐，自从放学起她的眼睛就没离开过那套衣服！

lines.en: : You teachers are all the same. I miss the days when my father would teach me numbers.
lines.zh: : 你们这些老师都是一个样。我怀念父亲教我数数的日子。

lines.en: scene anewinterview20
: Speaking of numbers, how old are you again?
lines.zh: : 说到数字，你今年多大来着？

lines.en: : Never ask a woman her age, you bastard. I could have your head for that.
lines.zh: : 永远别问女人的年龄，你这混蛋。就凭这句话我就能砍了你的头。

lines.en: : If it’s head you want, all you need to-
lines.zh: : 你要是想要「头」，你只需要——

lines.en: scene anewinterview21
: Fuck! No! Bad Imani!
lines.zh: : 操！不行！Imani 你给我收敛点！

lines.en: : I have to leave! Goodbye!
lines.zh: : 我得走了！再见！

lines.en: scene anewinterview22
: So, uhh...to get back to the topic of jokes, how do you feel now that you’ve finally been given a chance to show your stand-up chops in front of the rest of the guild?
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……回到笑话这个话题上，如今你终于有机会在众人面前展示自己的单口功力了，感觉如何？

lines.en: : Like I am on the brink of disappointing everyone.
lines.zh: : 就像我正站在让所有人失望的边缘。

lines.en: : But I heard from a wise man a long time ago that the best way to move forward is to...become uncomfortable. Or something along those lines.
lines.zh: : 但很久以前，一位智者告诉我，前进的最好方式就是……让自己变得不自在。大概是这个意思。

lines.en: : So I am willing to sacrifice myself for an effort to move forward. And if I do not, I will die as a warrior who made an effort to live and find a place in Valhalla as a tree.
lines.zh: : 所以我愿意为了前进而牺牲自己。就算不能，我也会作为一名努力活过的战士死去，在英灵殿里找到一棵树的位置。

lines.en: scene anewinterview23
: And your opponent? Are you worried about her at all?
lines.zh: : 那你的对手呢？你一点也不担心她吗？

lines.en: : Yes. She seems to be acting a bit differently as of late and I am not sure whether or not something may have happened to her.
lines.zh: : 担心。她最近表现得有点不一样，我不确定是不是发生了什么事。

lines.en: scene anewinterview24
: I...I was talking about worrying about her comedy, but...You think something happened to Ayane? She’s seemed mostly the same to me.
lines.zh: : 我……我是说担心她的段子，不过……你觉得 Ayane 出了什么事吗？在我看来她还是老样子啊。

lines.en: : Sometimes, the biggest changes are the ones buried the deepest. And we will never come to know them unless we submerge ourselves beneath it all.
lines.zh: : 有时候，最巨大的改变恰恰埋得最深。除非我们把自己彻底沉进去，否则永远无从知晓。

lines.en: : Huh...
scene anewinterview25
: So, the two of you were the ones chosen at random to participate in what has quickly become the most desired competition in all of the Dorm Wars. How does that feel?
lines.zh: : 那么，你们两位是被随机抽中，参加这场迅速成为整届宿舍大战中最抢手比赛的选手。感觉如何？

lines.en: : Honestly? Amazing. I’ve dreamt of this day ever since I was a little girl.
lines.zh: : 说实话？太棒了。我从还是个小女孩的时候就梦想着这一天。

lines.en: : Did I think it would be part of a contest? No. But any chance to show Sensei how much I love him is good enough for me. And I will take every single chance I ever have to do that.
lines.zh: : 我可没想到它会成为比赛的一部分。不过任何能向老师表达我有多爱他的机会，对我来说都足够好。而这样的机会，我一个都不会放过。

lines.en: : For me, it’s...well...a little less meaningful, I guess...
lines.zh: : 对我来说……嗯……大概没那么有意义吧……

lines.en: scene anewinterview26
: I obviously don’t have the sort of...emotional connection to Sensei that Noriko does given how long she’s known him, but...
lines.zh: : 我显然没有 Noriko 和老师之间那种……情感羁绊，毕竟她认识他那么久了，可是……

lines.en: : He’s made a big impact on my life and...I’m also happy with the opportunity to...probably lose to her.
lines.zh: : 他对我的人生影响很大，而且……我也很高兴能有这个机会……大概会输给她。

lines.en: : Don’t say that. You’ve got just as much of a chance as me. In fact, you might even have a {i}better{/i} chance since Sensei’s memories started exploding before I walked back into his life.
lines.zh: : 别这么说。你的机会和我一样大。事实上，说不定你的机会还{i}更大{/i}——毕竟在我重新走进他的人生之前，老师的记忆就已经开始炸裂了。

lines.en: : At the end of the day, all that really matters is that we stay true to ourselves and let him have some fun in the process. If we win, we win. If we lose, we lose.
lines.zh: : 说到底，真正重要的是我们忠于自己，同时让他在过程中玩得开心。赢了就赢了，输了就输了。

lines.en: scene anewinterview27
: And then we can all get naked and make out in my dorm room because that just seems like it would be the right thing to do after the two of us date the same guy for an entire day.
lines.zh: : 然后我们就可以在我的宿舍里脱光光亲热一番，毕竟我们俩跟同一个男人约会了一整天之后，这么做似乎才合情合理。

lines.en: : I...don’t really...want to do that...
lines.zh: : 我……不太……想那样……

lines.en: : Well, it was worth a shot. That costume’s got me feeling some sort of way, Futaba. And I apologize for displaying the same level of unrestrained arousal my roommate so typically does.
lines.zh: : 好吧，试试也无妨。这身衣服让我有点上头，Futaba。抱歉我表现出了和我室友如出一辙的那种毫不掩饰的兴奋。

lines.en: : Wow. Everybody’s just really horny for each other today, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 哇。今天大家一个个都饥渴得不行，是吧？

lines.en: scene anewinterview28
: It’s a weird time to be heterosexual, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这年头当个异性恋还挺难的，不是吗？

lines.en: : It really is.
lines.zh: : 确实如此。

lines.en: scene anewinterview29
: Speaking of people who are always horny, I’m joined now by Nodoka Nagasawa who is dressed up as...uhh...
lines.zh: : 说到总是很饥渴的人，现在我身边是 Nodoka Nagasawa，她打扮成了……呃……

lines.en: : Sada Abe.
lines.zh: : 阿部定。

lines.en: scene anewinterview30
: The...femme fatale who lopped off her lover’s penis and carried it around in her purse until she was arrested?
lines.zh: : 就是那个……把情人的阴茎割下来，装进手提包里一直带在身上，直到被捕的蛇蝎美人？

lines.en: : Once the rigor mortis sets in, it’s like it was never lopped off at all.
lines.zh: : 一旦尸僵开始，那就跟从来没被割下来过一样。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Okay. Well, moving right along, there’s a lot of uncertainty surrounding your competition in the Dorm Wars. Especially considering we don’t even know what that contest {i}is{/i} yet.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那，我们继续，关于你在宿舍大战中的比赛还有很多不确定因素。尤其是考虑到我们连那场比赛是{i}什么{/i}都还不知道。

lines.en: : If Yumi does agree to participate, are you worried at all that she’ll try to attack you again? And is that hostility playing any role at all in your battle plan to take her down for good?
lines.zh: : 如果 Yumi 真的同意参赛，你会担心她再次袭击你吗？这种敌意在你彻底击垮她的作战计划里，占了多大比重？

lines.en: scene anewinterview31
: Let me make one thing clear. I have no problem with Yumi. I think she’s a troubled girl who is genuinely attempting to better herself. And Futaba believes so as well after her recent apology.
lines.zh: : 我先说清楚一点。我对 Yumi 没有意见。我觉得她是个有问题的女孩，而且真心在试图变好。在她最近道歉之后，Futaba 也这么认为。

lines.en: : What issues she has with {i}me{/i} specifically, I’m not sure.
lines.zh: : 至于她具体对{i}我{/i}有什么意见，我不太清楚。

lines.en: : But I’m confident that her time away from class may have led to her reevaluating both her position in the social hierarchy that is high school as well as who she is as a person.
lines.zh: : 但我相信，离开班级的这段时间，或许让她重新审视了自己在高中这个社会等级中的位置，以及她自己究竟是个什么样的人。

lines.en: : I hold no grudge against her and wish her all the best.
lines.zh: : 我对她没有怨恨，也祝她一切顺利。

lines.en: scene anewinterview32
: That said, I can’t wait to make her grovel before my feet when I destroy her in whatever competition is chosen for us.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，我已经等不及要在我们被分到的那场比赛里把她打得跪地求饶了。

lines.en: : Oi, ain’t that a shocking condemnation if I’ve ever heard one. Final question, Nodoka- if there is any competition you’d {i}like{/i} to take on Yumi in, what would it be?
lines.zh: : 哦哟，这可真是我听过最惊人的反转了。最后一个问题，Nodoka——如果有机会{i}挑{/i}一场和 Yumi 比的比赛，你会选什么？

lines.en: : Hmm...that’s a good question.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这问题问得好。

lines.en: : But I think if I had to choose, I’d like something where the two of us are locked in a closet with Sensei and he has to choose which one of our-
lines.zh: : 不过如果一定要选，我想要那种——我们俩和老师被锁在一个柜子里，他必须选出我们当中谁的——

lines.en: scene anewinterview33
: Ayane, quick! We’re about to get cancelled!
lines.zh: : Ayane，快！我们要被封杀了！

lines.en: scene anewinterview34
: Not on my watch, we’re not! Maya, is it true that-
lines.zh: : 有我在就别想！Maya，是不是真的——

lines.en: : I won’t be taking any questions. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 我不接受任何提问。谢谢。

lines.en: : I will also be abstaining from...whatever is going on right now. I have zero interest in both the Dorm Wars and every single one of you, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 我也选择退出……眼下正在进行的这一切。无论是宿舍大战还是你们每一个人，我都毫无兴趣，所以……就这样。

lines.en: scene anewinterview35
: You guys make horrible interviewees. There are a bunch of people looking forward to seeing you in maid costumes, you know. I just wanted to ask some stuff about that.
lines.zh: : 你们俩真是糟糕的受访者。要知道，有一大堆人盼着看你们穿女仆装呢。我就是想问问这方面的事。

lines.en: : We have to wear the costumes too?
lines.zh: : 我们还得穿那身衣服？

lines.en: : I mean...I think {i}not{/i} doing that would cause you to lose some points, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我意思是……我觉得{i}不穿{/i}的话会扣分吧，不是吗？

lines.en: : Uta’s pretty adamant about dressing for the role, so she might get all pissy if you start doing maid stuff without looking like a maid.
lines.zh: : Uta 对「为角色而穿」这件事非常执着，所以要是你们干着女仆的活却一点不像女仆，她可能会翻脸。

lines.en: : But, then again, she’s also a kunoichi right now, so she might just assassinate you or something instead of throwing a hissy fit.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，她现在可是个女忍者，所以她也许会直接把你们暗杀掉，而不是发脾气。

lines.en: : That actually sounds preferable, to be honest. I’ll take the assassination.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那听起来反倒更好。我选被暗杀。

lines.en: : I’ll let her know. And congratulations on making it into my list of people I don’t inherently hate.
lines.zh: : 我会转告她的。另外恭喜你，成功跻身「我天生不讨厌的人」名单。

lines.en: scene anewinterview36
: What about me? Do you hate me as-
lines.zh: : 那我呢？你也讨厌我吗——

lines.en: : Yup.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Too loud. Too rich. Too blonde. And I have a natural distaste for anyone who gets naked with the guy I like, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 太吵。太有钱。头发太金。而且我天生就讨厌任何跟我喜欢的人上床的家伙，所以……就是这样。

lines.en: scene anewinterview37
: Oh yeah? Well I think you’re a...a...
lines.zh: : 是吗？那我觉得你是个……一个……

lines.en: : I think you’re going to lose!
lines.zh: : 我觉得你会输！

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re probably right. Losing’s pretty on brand for me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你大概是对的。输对我来说也挺符合人设的。

lines.en: : Okay. I’m going back inside now.
lines.zh: : 好了。我回屋里去了。

lines.en: scene anewinterview38
: Molly here again! This time with Kirin Kanda and Ami Arakawa! And since none of us have any idea what they’re going to be competing in yet, I’m just going to ask them some random questions!
lines.zh: : 又是我 Molly！这次请到的是 Kirin Kanda 和 Ami Arakawa！既然连我们都不知道她们要比什么，那我就随便问几个问题好了！

lines.en: : Can you start by asking Kirin why she has her arm around me when we’ve barely even talked before?
lines.zh: : 你能不能先问问 Kirin，我们俩几乎没说过话，她为什么搂着我？

lines.en: : Kirin, why do you-
lines.zh: : Kirin，你为什么——

lines.en: : Just trying to get a little closer to my rival, that’s all! If you and me build up our camaraderie before our contest is decided on, it’ll hurt a little less when one of us loses!
lines.zh: : 只是想和我的对手亲近一点而已！如果我们能在比赛定下来之前先培养出点战友情，那到时候谁输了也不会太难受！

lines.en: : You mean when {i}you{/i} lose. There’s no way I’d ever lose in a Sensei-based contest to someone who doesn’t even love Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你是说{i}你{/i}输的时候吧。我怎么可能在一场以老师为主题的比赛里，输给一个根本不爱老师的人。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? You think you can beat me at literally {i}everything?{/i}
lines.zh: : 是吗？你觉得你在{i}任何事情{/i}上都能赢我？

lines.en: : Is there...something you’re good at? Because I really have no idea since, again, we’ve never talked.
lines.zh: : 你……有什么擅长的吗？因为我真的完全不知道，毕竟，再说一遍，我们从来没说过话。

lines.en: scene anewinterview39
: I’m good at plenty of things. I just shouldn’t say any of them on live television in case my parents are watching.
lines.zh: : 我擅长的多了去了。只是不能在全国家庭直播里说出来，万一我爸妈在看呢。

lines.en: : Oooh...it looks like we’ve got a true competitor in our midst if the contest between these two winds up being x-rated!...Which it probably won’t because there’s no way that would be approved.
lines.zh: : 哦哦……要是这两个人的比赛最后变成限制级的，那我们可真是遇上真正的劲敌了！……不过多半不会，毕竟那种东西肯定批不下来。

lines.en: : And also because this isn’t one of those fake game shows that get all porny out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 而且这又不是那种突然就变得色情兮兮的假游戏节目。

lines.en: scene anewinterview40
: Oh, like the ones where people wind up blindly fucking their siblings without knowing?! I love those!
lines.zh: : 哦，就是那种人在不知情的情况下跟自己亲兄弟姐妹乱搞的？！我超爱那种！

lines.en: : There’s one I saw where this guy railed the {i}fuck{/i} out of his sister like ten times harder when he {i}found out{/i} it was her. That’s the shit I live for.
lines.zh: : 我看过一期，那男的{i}发现{/i}对方是自己亲妹妹之后，反而干得{i}更狠{/i}了十倍。我就是为这种东西活的。

lines.en: : A comrade! Your degeneracy has finally appealed to me in a way that I can relate to instead of a way that makes me feel self-conscious!
lines.zh: : 同志！你的堕落终于以一种我能共鸣的方式打动了我，而不是让我自惭形秽！

lines.en: : I saw one of those once. It was an uncle who wound up having sex with his niece.
lines.zh: : 我也看过一期。是一个叔叔最后和自己侄女上了床。

lines.en: scene anewinterview41
: Uhh...ain’t that a little on the nose?
lines.zh: : 呃……这也太直白了吧？

lines.en: : On what nose?
lines.zh: : 什么直白？

lines.en: : I guess I’ll do my duty as a reporter and ask...Ami, there are many rumors about your true feelings regarding your uncle.
lines.zh: : 那我就履行一下记者的职责，问一句……Ami，关于你对你叔叔的真实感情，外界有很多传言。

lines.en: : I know. I’ve heard them.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我都听说了。

lines.en: : Then...do you have anything you'd like to say in regard to them?
lines.zh: : 那么……对此你有什么想说的吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Can I make a comment?
lines.zh: : 我能说两句吗？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Cool.
: I hope our contest is one of those game show things.
lines.zh: : 我希望我们的比赛就是那种游戏节目的玩意儿。

lines.en: scene anewinterview42

: We’re getting close to the end now, folks! This is Ayane Amamiya once again, and my final interview for the day is with none other than the competitors for this year’s popularity poll! Otoha Okakura and-
lines.zh: : 各位，我们快接近尾声了！我是 Ayane Amamiya，今天最后一场采访的对象，正是今年人气投票的两位选手！Otoha Okakura 和——

lines.en: scene anewinterview43
: Wait, Chika- I thought you went to go meet up with Yumi?
lines.zh: : 等等，Chika——我以为你去见 Yumi 了？

lines.en: : You know, I was going to. But when I heard “popularity poll,” I felt like I should do a few laps around the school to make sure I lock in as many votes as I can.
lines.zh: : 我本来是要去的。可一听到「人气投票」，我就觉得该绕着学校跑几圈，好把能拉的票都锁死。

lines.en: scene anewinterview44
: Spoken like a true Sensei-lover. I can respect that.
lines.zh: : 这话说得，活脱脱一个痴迷老师的人。我敬你是条汉子。

lines.en: : {i}Me?{/i} Pfft. Of {i}course{/i} not. Isn’t he like, forty?
lines.zh: : {i}我？{/i}切。{i}才不是{/i}。他都四十了吧？

lines.en: : Plus, I’m still going to meet up with Yumi. I’m just doing it after this instead. Figured I might as well stick around and show Otoha I mean business.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我还是要去见 Yumi 的，只是改成采访之后再去。我想不如留下来，让 Otoha 看看我是动真格的。

lines.en: : And Otoha, do you have any plans to counter this aggressive attack so early on from your opponent?
lines.zh: : 那么 Otoha，面对对手这么早就发动的猛烈攻势，你有什么应对计划吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...not really, no. I was kind of just hoping people would keep doing that thing they do and...wanting to get close to me for whatever reason.
lines.zh: : 呃……其实没有。我就是指望大家继续做他们一直在做的那件事……出于某种原因想靠近我。

lines.en: : And I ain’t really about walking around wearing next to nothing just to get votes.
lines.zh: : 而且我可不喜欢为了拉票就穿得跟没穿似的到处晃。

lines.en: scene anewinterview45
: Umm, Otoha- do dogs wear clothes? Obviously not. And I am {i}clearly{/i} a wolf-girl, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Otoha——狗会穿衣服吗？显然不会。而我{i}明摆着{/i}是个狼女，所以……就是这样。

lines.en: : Sorry, {i}is{/i} that clear? Because you look a lot more like a living mascot for petplay than an actual animal to me.
lines.zh: : 不好意思，哪里{i}明摆着{/i}了？因为在我看来，你与其像一只真正的动物，倒更像一个活生生的宠物扮演吉祥物。

lines.en: : Wanna try it on? I bet your girlfriend likes it.
lines.zh: : 想试试吗？我打赌你女朋友会喜欢。

lines.en: scene anewinterview46
: Don’t fucking joke about that. It’s not funny.
lines.zh: : 别他妈拿这个开玩笑。一点都不好笑。

lines.en: : I obviously wasn’t serious. Chill.
lines.zh: : 我显然不是认真的。冷静点。

lines.en: : Uhhh...okay! So, without sowing any more seeds of destruction, I’d like to wish the two of you the best of luck in your poll and urge you to keep campaigning as hard as you can!
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧！那么，在不继续播下更多毁灭种子的前提下，我祝你们两位在投票中好运，也请你们继续全力拉票！

lines.en: scene anewinterview47
: And remember, folks! Be sure to vote! Wasting your vote is the same thing as wasting your voice, and you’d never want to throw that away, would you?!
lines.zh: : 记住了，各位！一定要投票！浪费选票就等于浪费你的声音，你总不会想把声音扔掉吧？！

lines.en: : This is Ayane Amamiya, signing off! Back to you for the final interview, Molly!
lines.zh: : 我是 Ayane Amamiya，就到这里！最后一场采访交回给你，Molly！

lines.en: scene anewinterview48
: Thanks, Ayane! And thank you Miku and Uta for joining me for the final interview of the-
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Ayane！也谢谢 Miku 和 Uta 来参加最后一场采访——

lines.en: : Ughhhhh! Whatever! This is like, so totally boring. Like, Dorm Wars? Seriously? Don’t you guys have any friends? Is this really what you do for fun?
lines.zh: : 呃啊啊啊！随便啦！这也太无聊了吧。什么嘛，宿舍大战？认真的吗？你们这些人都没有朋友的吗？你们平时就靠这个找乐子？

lines.en: : The idea of “fun” does not exist. All we have is silence....shadows...the dark...and a mission. A mission to remain unseen. {i}Unheard.{/i} Unnoticed...
lines.zh: : 「乐趣」这个概念并不存在。我们所拥有的只有寂静……暗影……黑暗……以及一项使命。一项保持不被看见、{i}不被听见{/i}、不被察觉的使命……

lines.en: scene anewinterview49

: Tch. Ain’t “unnoticed” the same thing as “unheard” and “unseen?” That’s like, totally adorable. Look at you trying so hard to act cool. It’s hilarious. Can I take a pic? I’ll tag you. What’s your insta?
lines.zh: : 切。「不被察觉」不就是「不被听见」和「不被看见」吗？这简直太可爱了。瞧你拼命装酷的样子，笑死我了。我能拍张照吗？我会 @ 你的。你 ins 账号多少？

lines.en: : I do not understand the concepts of which you speak...nor the wretched scent of that perfume nor impractical accessories you don as if they are protection.
lines.zh: : 我无法理解你所说的那些概念……也无法理解那香水的难闻气味，以及你戴着的好似护身符一般毫无用处的配饰。

lines.en: : They {i}are{/i} protection, doll. They’re protecting me from looking so {i}stupid.{/i} Like, where did you even get that scarf? Goodwill?
lines.zh: : 它们{i}就是{/i}护身符啊，小可爱。它们正保护我不至于看起来那么{i}蠢{/i}。话说你那条围巾哪儿买的？二手店？

lines.en: : I have to say, this is going a lot better than I expected it to and I have to applaud both of you for both your fantastic costume design {i}and{/i} your commitment to your respective roles.
lines.zh: : 我得说，这比我预想的顺利多了，我必须为你们二位出色的服装设计，{i}以及{/i}对各自角色的投入鼓掌。

lines.en: scene anewinterview50
: It’s a risky move choosing to dress and act like a gyaru while we already have one in- uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 在我们已经有一个辣妹的情况下，还选择打扮成辣妹的样子，这步棋可有点冒险——啊哦。

lines.en: : Trouble approaches like morning dew. Quiet...but consistent. Reliable.
lines.zh: : 麻烦如晨露般逼近。安静……却连绵不绝。可靠。

lines.en: scene anewinterview51
: Uhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Miku...
lines.zh: : Miku……

lines.en: : I...can totally, like...explain...
lines.zh: : 我……完全可以，那个……解释……

lines.en: : This is-
lines.zh: : 这是——

lines.en: scene anewinterview52
: YOU ARE SO FREAKING PRECIOUS, OH MY GOD!
lines.zh: : 你也太他妈可爱了吧，我的天哪！

lines.en: : Where’d you get your top? And those bracelets? You have to show me. Just not today since I’ve got other stuff to do.
lines.zh: : 你这件上衣哪儿买的？还有那些手链？你一定得带我去。不过不是今天，我今天还有别的事。

lines.en: scene anewinterview53
: Oh! We should, like...totally go shopping together soon. I can show you all sorts of places with great stuff for mad cheap that-
lines.zh: : 哦！我们真该，那个……赶紧一起去逛街。我可以带你去各种地方，东西超好还贼便宜，而且——

lines.en: : Chika, Miku’s disguise is simply a temporary item set that-
lines.zh: : Chika，Miku 的伪装只是一套临时道具，它——

lines.en: scene anewinterview54
: Shut your fucking mouth, Molly! Let me talk to Miku alone! No one else ever dresses like me and I finally have someone to bond with even if it’s fake!
lines.zh: : 闭上你的臭嘴，Molly！让我单独跟 Miku 说话！从来没人穿得像我这样，我终于找到一个能聊到一起的人了，哪怕这是假的！

lines.en: : Uhh...umm...
: Miku, you have a...tanning appointment in five minutes. Or something.
lines.zh: : Miku，你五分钟后……有个美黑预约。大概吧。

lines.en: scene anewinterview55
: R-Right! That, like...totes slipped my mind! Thankies, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 对——对哦！那个，我，那个……完全给忘了！谢啦，Makoto！

lines.en: : Wait! Come back! We weren’t done bonding! I love you!
lines.zh: : 等等！回来！我们还没聊完呢！我爱你！

lines.en: : Gone...like the color of the Chitose River in winter...waiting for its moment to return. But when? And who will be there to watch as the color returns?
lines.zh: : 消失了……如同冬日里千岁河的颜色……静候着它归来的那一刻。可是何时？当颜色归来之时，又会有谁在那里见证？

lines.en: scene anewinterview56
scene anewinterview57
: Wshhhh...
scene black

: This concludes our second annual pre-war interviews! Thanks so much for watching and be sure to keep an eye out as the contests kick off first thing in the morning when I take on floor one’s Sana Sakakibara!
lines.zh: : 第二届赛前采访到此结束！非常感谢收看，明早比赛一打响，请大家务必关注——我将迎战一楼的 Sana Sakakibara！

lines.en: : Until then...Stay modest! Stay Molly!
lines.zh: : 在那之前……保持矜持！保持 Molly！

lines.en: : Seele out!
lines.zh: : Seele，完毕！

lines.en: : You know that’s not what that character is like at all, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道那个角色根本不是这样的吧？

lines.en: : I actually haven’t even played the game yet.
lines.zh: : 其实我连那款游戏都还没玩过。
